## 分诊：`domain:ui` / `bug` + `finding` / **`needs-user-decision`** / **`priority:p2`**

⛔ `needs-user-decision` 不与 `pm:*` 并存。

## 落点核实（`origin/main`）——**两处 `any` 逐字命中，且替代类型确实已发布**

```
packages/react/src/context/SchemaRendererContext.tsx
  interface SchemaRendererContextType {
    dataSource: any;          ← ①  上下文类型，整棵树读回的东西
    …
  }: {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    dataSource: any;          ← ②  Provider 自己的 props
    …
  }

packages/types/src/data.ts:330   export interface DataSource<T = any> {     ← 已发布、已导出
```

⇒ **类型是已知的、已发布的、并且一跳之外已经在用**（卡片：`packages/app-shell/README.md` 已写 `declare const myDataSource: DataSource;` 对着同一个缝；本包的 `useSettledSchema` 已把参数声明为 `DataSource<any> | null | undefined`）—— **只是没有声明在这里。**

⚠️ 本席**未复现**那次 planted probe（把 `dataSource={adapter}` 换成 `dataSource={'not-an-adapter'}`，`check:doc-snippets` **exit 0、零诊断**）。⛔ 不把源码核对当成对它的复现继承。⭐ **但那次探针的方法是对的**：方向**预先写下**预测为 GREEN，然后实测 GREEN ⇒ 这不是「找不到反例」，是**一次预测被证实的负结果**。

---

## 为什么定 **p2** —— 比它的同类 #7483 更中心

卡片自己给了对比，本席核实后背书：

> This is the same defect class as **#7483** (`ObjectView`'s props surface typed `any`), on a different and **arguably more central** surface: `ObjectView` is **one route-level view**, whereas **`SchemaRendererProvider` is the injection point for the entire renderer tree**, and **`useSchemaContext()` hands the `any` to every consumer that reads it back.**

⇒ 两处 `any` 不是并列的：**① 是每一个消费者读回时拿到的类型**，⇒ 这个 `any` **会传染到整棵树**。

⭐ 而卡片对危害具体化得很好：**「把一个字符串传到宿主适配器该在的位置」不是一个假想的错误，它正是「从错误的地方读来的配置值」的形状，而它会在第一次 `find()` 时于运行期炸掉。** ⇒ 编译期本可以拦，且**该块现在已经在被 `--strict` 编译**——**门在跑，只是无话可说。**

⛔ **不到 p1**：⛔ 无当前故障、无数据风险；损害是**编译器对一个中心接缝无话可说**。⛔ **不降 p3**：它是**发布产物里的类型**（`packages/react/dist/context/SchemaRendererContext.d.ts:11` / `:20` 原样带着 `any`），⇒ **每一个下游消费者都拿不到任何信息**；且它与 AGENTS.md #0.1 / #6（「类型安全高于魔法——不要 `any`」）直接冲突。

## 为什么是决定箱

卡片自陈，本席同意：

> Narrowing `dataSource: any` to `DataSource` is **a public-contract change on `@object-ui/react`**, and **it will red every internal caller that passes an adapter this repo has not typed.** That is a scoped piece of work with its own blast radius, not a rider on a documentation-ledger batch. **The measurement is recorded; the decision is not taken.**

⇒ 收窄一个已发布 prop 的类型 = 破坏性变更 + 一个未测量的内部爆炸半径。⛔ 本席不裁决（本会话 `claude-opus-5`，`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 硬门要求 fable）。

**需要裁决者答的一句话：`SchemaRendererProvider.dataSource` 应当声明为已发布的 `DataSource` 契约，还是保持 `any` 并明写「宿主适配器的形状不由 TypeScript 守」？**

⚠️ **裁决前必须补的一项读数（本席与卡片都没做）：把 `dataSource: any` 收成 `DataSource` 会红掉多少个内部调用点。** 卡片说「every internal caller that passes an adapter this repo has not typed」——**那个数字没人量过**，而它直接决定这次收窄的价钱。⇒ **这是取卡人的第一步。**

⚠️ **第二条**：`SchemaRendererContextType.dataSource`（①）与 Provider props（②）**可以分开处理**——先收窄 ① 会影响每一个 `useSchemaContext()` 的读回点，先收窄 ② 只影响注入点。⇒ **两者的爆炸半径不同，请分别估。**

**Related**：**#7483**（同缺陷类，`ObjectView` 的 props 面，`@object-ui/app-shell`）· **#7927**（`BaseSchema` 的 `[key: string]: any`——同一族「一个宽松声明让一整类检查失效」，本轮本席已路由为 p2 决定箱）· #5174 / PR #7910（发现现场；⭐ 该 PR **把这条作为它新增覆盖的已发布边界写了下来，而不是让绿色暗示更多** —— 本席特别记名这条纪律）。

---
⛔ 本席为 triage 席位：不认领、不派单、不写码、不合并、不裁决 decision-box。

## Ruling recorded — declare the published `DataSource` contract at the seam (director seat, decision batch #68, 2026-09-07)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「同意」 (all five batch #68 recommendations adopted).

**Ruling.** `SchemaRendererProvider`'s `dataSource` prop **and** `SchemaRendererContextType.dataSource` are typed `DataSource` (from `@object-ui/types`), not `any`. "Keep `any` and document that the host adapter's shape is not TypeScript's job" is refused: it contradicts AGENTS.md #0.1 / #6 on the most central seam of the renderer tree.

**Execution notes.**
1. Measure first: count the internal call sites that go red when each of the two `any`s is narrowed (the context type reaches every `useSchemaContext()` reader; the prop reaches only injection points). Record both numbers on this card before the PR; if the context narrowing is large, land it in the same PR anyway — a half-typed seam is the thing this ruling ends — but say what it cost.
2. Fix the red call sites by typing the adapters, never by casting to `any` at the seam.
3. Published TS accept set narrows (`@object-ui/react`): Clause-② **yes**, `needs:contract-review`, changeset stating the type change.
4. Pin: the planted probe from this card (`dataSource={'not-an-adapter'}`) must fail `check:doc-snippets`.
5. #7483 (`ObjectView` props typed `any`) follows the same direction; note there when this lands.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger on objectstack#12708 (batch #68).

## Dispatch — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), round R31

Claimed: objectstack-ai/objectui#7912 — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) at R31.
Clause-②: yes

### ⛔ This card is ALREADY RULED — read both comments in full before anything else (rule 38)
- `5557243165` — triage: the two `any` sites verified verbatim, the p2 grading, and **two readings it explicitly left undone**.
- `5565350616` — ⭐ **the director seat's recorded ruling, decision batch #68, maintainer verbatim 「同意」.** It is **BINDING** and it carries five numbered execution notes. ⛔ The decision is made: there is nothing here to re-open.

**The ruling:** `SchemaRendererProvider`'s `dataSource` prop **and** `SchemaRendererContextType.dataSource` are typed **`DataSource`** (from `@object-ui/types`), ⛔ **not `any`**. "Keep `any` and document that the host adapter's shape is not TypeScript's job" was **refused** — it contradicts AGENTS.md #0.1 / #6 on the most central seam of the renderer tree.

### ⭐ Execution note 1 is your FIRST step, and it is a measurement nobody has taken
> **Measure first**: count the internal call sites that go red when **each** of the two `any`s is narrowed … Record **both numbers on this card before the PR**.

⚠️ The two have **different blast radii and must be estimated separately**:
- **① `SchemaRendererContextType.dataSource`** reaches **every `useSchemaContext()` reader** — this `any` is the one that infects the whole tree.
- **② the Provider's own props** reaches only the **injection points**.

⭐ **If the context narrowing turns out large, land it in the same PR anyway** — the ruling says so in as many words: *"a half-typed seam is the thing this ruling ends — but say what it cost."*

### ⛔ Execution notes 2–5, quoted because each is a fence
2. ⛔ **Fix red call sites by typing the adapters, never by casting to `any` at the seam.** A cast at the seam re-creates the defect one line lower.
3. **The published TS accept set narrows** on `@object-ui/react` ⇒ Clause-② **yes**, `needs:contract-review`, and a changeset stating the type change. ⚠️ 41 packages sit in ONE `fixed` group ⇒ `major` is unavailable; breaking ships as **`minor` with a `**BREAKING**` carrier**. Shape it after objectui#8604 / objectui#9187 (FROM/TO).
4. ⭐ **Pin: the planted probe from the card must FAIL `check:doc-snippets`** — `dataSource={adapter}` → `dataSource={'not-an-adapter'}` on the `SchemaRendererProvider` example in `packages/react/README.md`. ⚠️ Today that probe **exits 0 with zero diagnostics** in a block already compiled `--strict` against the built types: **the gate is running and has nothing to say.** Your pin is that it starts having something to say.
5. **objectui#7483** (`ObjectView` props typed `any`) follows the same direction — ⛔ do not fix it here, but **note there when this lands**.

### ⭐ A live, freshly measured input the card does not have
PR objectui#9289 (card objectui#9197) just landed the **sibling** repair: `RecordContextValue.dataSource` was declared `string` while every producer passed an adapter, and it is now `DataSource`. ⭐ That seat measured something directly useful to you: **five `as any` casts in `@object-ui/fields` read `SchemaRendererContext`, not `RecordContext`** — they are redundant against `any` today and are **exactly the consumer face this card types**. ⇒ they are part of your red-call-site count, and they were deliberately left for you.
⚠️ **Key it on the BINDING, not the variable name.** That same seat found triage's cast list keyed on the identifier `ctx`, giving a count that agreed with the real one by coincidence while **overlapping on only six of eleven**.

### ⚠️ In flight — check before you edit
PR objectui#9289 touches `packages/react/src/context/RecordContext.tsx` and may still be in the merge queue when you start. **Your file is `SchemaRendererContext.tsx`** — a different file in the same directory. ⛔ Confirm that rather than assume it. Also live: objectui#8021 (docs guide) and objectui#7561 (`packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`).

### Standing constraints for this round
- Read `AGENTS.md` in full before your first edit. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**/*.tsx` is a **No-Touch zone** (Commandment #7).
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never force-push or rewrite pushed history.
- ⚠️ There is **no npm script matching `no-major`**. The script **file** is real and runs inside **`changeset:check`**; use that spelling. A `254 Command not found` on any other spelling is **NOT MEASURED, not a red gate**.
- objectui has **no** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; derive the gate family by hand from `package.json` + `.github/workflows/`.
- ⚠️ **A package-scoped test run is not the blast radius** (objectui#9273) — and on this card the blast radius is the point. Run the union of every package whose call sites you touched, plus `examples/schema-catalog/`.
- ⚠️ **Install/build first.** A missing `node_modules` makes **every** `require.resolve` fail identically — **instrument failure, not a negative answer**. Read verdicts from the verify-lock wrapper's VERDICT line, never a bare `$?`. ⚠️ The shared lock has been heavily contended today; park the slot and report **NOT MEASURED** rather than running unlocked.
- ⚠️ **Carrier rule:** hang `needs:contract-review` on **both** limbs in one stroke. ⛔ **Never clear either limb**; clearing is the PM's. (REST label POST needs `Content-Type: application/json`, else **415** — ⛔ not a permission failure.)
- ⛔ Do **not** put any model identifier into any pushed artifact. ⭐ This repo's history is currently **inconsistent** on it — one commit landed today carrying one — so ⛔ do not copy a neighbouring commit's trailer; use the model-free form. ⛔ Card relations belong in the **PR body**, not the commit message.

### ⭐ The two instrument standards this seat holds
1. **Write the pin BEFORE you touch the code** — the "unmodified" arm is then the real base tree. ⭐ Here that is unusually clean: the doc-snippet probe **already fails to fail** on today's tree, so plant it first and record the green as the base reading.
2. **Every control must be able to fire.** ⚠️ A type-level pin's characteristic failure is the harness **degrading the types to `any`**, which silently inverts every row while looking perfect. Carry controls that prove resolution is real — a misspelled key must be refused, and `DataSource`'s required members must be visible.

## 执行注记 1 的读数 —— 两个 `any` 各自的爆炸半径,分别量过(PR 之前)

⚠️ 本评论不写任何尖括号形状的片段(GitHub 会静默吃掉它们,而本卡正是关于 JSX 属性的)。
凡该写 JSX 元素处,一律写成「SchemaRendererProvider 元素」。

### 量具

- 基线 `243fc8317`(`origin/main`,#9289 合并前)。总体 = `@object-ui/react` 加它的全部下游消费者
  共 **33** 个包(`pnpm --filter '...@object-ui/react'`,排除 `@object-ui/site`),每个包两层
  (`tsc --noEmit` 与 `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`)。
- 每次变体只重新 emit `@object-ui/react` 的 `dist/*.d.ts`;其余每个包都对着**基线构建**的 dist
  受检,所以读数里没有构建级联噪声。
- **基线读数:66 个 task 全绿、0 条诊断**(`VERDICT command-exit 0`,锁下 3m53s)。于是任何诊断都
  可归因到那一次收窄。

### ① `SchemaRendererContextType.dataSource`(整棵树读回的那个)→ `DataSource`

**7 条诊断 · 7 个行位置 · 5 个文件 · 4 个包**,而且**全部是生产代码或被 mock 的模块工厂**:

| 包 | 位置 | 诊断 |
|---|---|---|
| `@object-ui/react` | `src/context/SchemaRendererContext.tsx:67` | TS7053 —— `useDataScope` 按路径索引注入值 |
| `@object-ui/react` | `src/hooks/useClientNotifications.ts:84` `:85` | TS2339 —— `getClient` 不是 `DataSource` 成员 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-list` | `src/ObjectGallery.tsx:431` `:490` | TS2322 —— 它自带一份手搓的 `{ find }` 替身 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` | `src/registration.test.tsx:38` | TS2769 —— `vi.mock` 工厂返回的假 context |
| `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` | `src/registration.test.tsx:14` | TS2769 —— 同上 |

两条必须一起报的限定:

- **另有 6 条级联诊断,不是调用点**:`@object-ui/plugin-list` 的 `vite build` 在 ObjectGallery 红着
  时发不出 `.d.ts`,于是 `@object-ui/app-shell`(4)、`@object-ui/plugin-map`(1)、`apps/console`(1)
  报 TS7016「找不到声明文件」。plugin-list 一编译通过它们就全部消失,所以**不计入** ① 的数。
- ⚠️ **① 之下 `@object-ui/react` 自己的 test 层 NOT MEASURED**:包的 `type-check` 是
  `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`,第一条腿红了就短路掉第二条。`@object-ui/plugin-list`
  同理。两个包的 test 层由下面「落地形状」那一轮补齐,那一轮两层都跑到了。

### ② SchemaRendererProvider 自己的 props → `DataSource`

**52 条诊断 · 52 个行位置 · 27 个文件 · 11 个包**。`@object-ui/react` 的 src 这一变体下编译干净
(0 条),所以每个包两层都测到了,没有短路、没有级联。

| 包 | 诊断数 |
|---|---|
| `@object-ui/react` | 23 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` | 8 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-list` | 8 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-charts` | 3 |
| `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` | 3 |
| `examples/schema-catalog` | 2 |
| `@object-ui/components` · `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` · `@object-ui/plugin-detail` · `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` · `@object-ui/plugin-map` | 各 1 |

**其中恰好 1 条是生产代码**:`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/react-page.tsx:205` —— 它把
一个空对象当作「适配器还没连上」的占位常量。其余 51 条全是测试注入点。

### ⭐ 排序与卡上的预测**相反**,这是本次测量最该记下的一句

裁决与派发都预期 ① 是贵的那一半(它传染整棵树),② 只够到注入点。实测**反过来**,而且差 7.4 倍:

- ① 便宜,因为树里每一个读回点**本来就都守了**(`ctx?.dataSource`、`if (!dataSource)`),而且没有
  任何一个读到 `find` / `getObjectSchema` 之外的成员 —— 也就是说,消费者侧早已按适配器在用它。
- ② 贵,因为注入点绝大多数是**测试替身**,而它们从来不是完整适配器:空对象、只有 `find`、
  只有 `queryDataset`、`undefined`、`null`,以及纯数据袋。

⇒ 「半类型化的接缝」这次的代价,几乎全部落在**替身的完整性**上,而不落在消费者的类型上。

### 落地形状(两处一起收窄)与它的读数

两处都声明为 **`DataSource | null | undefined`** —— 与本包 `useSettledSchema` 早已使用的拼写逐字
相同(卡片正文引的正是它)。理由:`null` / `undefined` 是真实运行状态(Studio 预览、react 页面在
宿主适配器连上之前、只驱动 `apiFetch` 的 widget 探针),树里每个读回点都为它守过;而这个联合体
拒绝的恰好是全部非适配器 —— 字符串、空对象、数据袋、缺必需成员的部分适配器。

该形状下的读数(两层全测到):**54 条诊断**。与 ②(严格 `DataSource`)相比:

- 8 个显式传 `undefined` / `null` 的注入点**清零**(它们本来就是合法状态);
- **新出 3 个生产位置** —— `plugin-calendar` / `plugin-gantt` / `plugin-kanban` 的 `src/index.tsx`
  把可空的 context 适配器交给自家 widget,而 widget 的 prop 只声明 `dataSource?: DataSource`。
  三处都在读回点把两种「没有」收敛成 widget 声明的那一种。

### 执行注记 4 的钉子(pin):同一个探针,前后两次读数

卡片那个 planted probe(把 `packages/react/README.md` 里 SchemaRendererProvider 例子的
`dataSource={adapter}` 换成 `dataSource={'not-an-adapter'}`),在**未改动的基线树**上先量一次,
作为「未修改」那条腿:

```
基线 243fc8317,dist 已构建: exit 0 · 646/646 blocks judged, 0 failed · 零诊断
落地后同一个探针:        exit 1 · packages/react/README.md:110:3
                          TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'DataSource'
```

⇒ 门原来在跑而无话可说,现在有话可说了。探针已还原(blob 与 HEAD 逐字节相同)。

⭐ **同一个门顺手抓到一处真红,不是探针**:`content/docs/guide/quick-start.md:112` 教的就是
`dataSource={{}}`(空对象),TS2740。已按契约修好(该例渲染内联 `data`,没有适配器可注入,
所以写 `undefined`),并把那一段散文改成说明这三种状态。修完 `pnpm check:doc-snippets` 回到
exit 0、646/646、0 failed。

### PM 那五个 `@object-ui/fields` 的 cast —— 按 BINDING 逐个申报

五个全在,全已删,且**每一个的 binding 现在都是真类型**(`React.useContext(SchemaRendererContext)`
→ `SchemaRendererContextType | null`,无任何上游 `as any`):

| 位置 | 原写法 | 现在 | binding 是否仍被上游 launder |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src/index.tsx:133` | `ctx?.dataSource as any` | 无 cast | **否** —— 这一处没有第二个来源,读回值完整带类型 |
| `src/widgets/ObjectRefField.tsx:40` | `(ctx as any)?.dataSource` | 无 cast | context 腿**否**;合并后的局部仍是 `any`,原因见下 |
| `src/widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx:432` | 同上 | 无 cast | 同上 |
| `src/widgets/RecipientPickerField.tsx:62` | 同上 | 无 cast | 同上 |
| `src/widgets/CapabilityMultiSelectField.tsx:156` | 同上 | 无 cast | 同上 |

⚠️ **仍然 launder 的那半,已定位到唯一一处声明,且不是这个接缝**:后四处把 context 腿与
`props.dataSource` 合并,而 `FieldWidgetProps.dataSource` 在 `@object-ui/fields` 自己的
`widgets/types.ts:179` 声明为 `unknown`(注释写明是刻意的:"Left structural (`unknown`):
`@object-ui/fields` must not depend on a concrete adapter")。合并后的局部因此仍标注 `any`。
那是另一个包面的声明,本卡不动它,但四处都写了注释点名它 —— 于是「读起来干净而 binding 是 any」
这件事在这四处是**有名字的**,不是隐形的。

⭐ **PM 那条陷阱在 `fields` 里还有第二个实例,已修**:`widgets/LookupField.tsx:60` 把导入的
context **重新声明**成一个 `any` 的 `React.Context` —— 一个 binding 级的加宽,使该文件里每一处
`ctx?.…` 读上去完全类型化而实际是 `any`,`dataSource` 读也一样被洗掉。现在按声明使用导入,只把
objectui#7206 那条尾巴(`formValues` / `data`,context 并未声明的成员)走一个**局部**加宽视图,
所以加宽只出现在它真正发生的那一行,够不到 `dataSource`。

⚠️ 还有一处 binding 级 `as any` **故意留着**:`widgets/useCascadingOptions.ts:45` 的
`useContext(SchemaRendererContext) as any`。它**唯一**的读是那条 #7206 尾巴,本文件不读
`dataSource`,收窄它就要红掉 objectui#7206 明确不裁的那两个成员 —— 所以按「留在原样」处理,
在此申报,不静默。

### 不是我的那两个

`plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx:99` 与 `plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx:94`
的 `useRecordContext() as any` 是另一个 context、另一条声明,已由 PM 立为 objectui#9304,
**没有**进本 PR、**没有**计入上面任何一个数。
